title: Iran closes its airspace by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran initiates a major closure of its airspace, that is not solely due to weather conditions, by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A “major closure” is defined as a broad closure, cancellation, or suspension of commercial flights transiting, arriving in, and departing from Iranian airspace or a major Iranian Airspace region. A qualifying closure must apply generally to flights across Iran or a major Iranian airspace region. Limited cancellations, delays, or other partial closures will not qualify. Limited exceptions to a broad closure, however, will not disqualify such a closure from counting (e.g. exceptions for certain flights pre-approved by the Iranian Civil Aviation Authority may be permitted). 

Any non-weather complete suspension of commercial arrivals and departures affecting at least two of the following airports will qualify: Imam Khomeini International Airport (IKA), Mehrabad Airport (THR), Mashhad International Airport (MHD), Shiraz International Airport (SYZ), or Isfahan International Airport (IFN).

Qualifying previous examples include the January 2026 total closure of Iranian airspace except to international flights with express governmental permission (https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iran-shuts-airspace-most-flights-flightradar24-says-2026-01-14/) and the April 2024 closure of Iran’s western airspace (https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/iranian-airports-cancel-flights-until-monday-morning-2024-04-14/). Non-qualifying examples include the January 27, 2026 partial closure of Iranian airspace around the Strait of Hormuz (https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/iran-issues-airspace-notice-for-military-drills-near-strait-of-hormuz/3812508) and the January 25 - April 25, 2026 VFR (Visual Flight Rules) flights suspension which did not broadly close commercial aviation in a qualifying region (https://www.intellinews.com/iran-suspends-general-aviation-and-vfr-flights-in-new-airspace-directive-421997/).

Warnings, No-Fly-Zones, or other flight restrictions imposed by airlines or countries other than Iran will not be sufficient for a “Yes” resolution.

Airspace closures which occur solely due to weather conditions will not qualify.

The primary resolution sources for this market will be official information from Iranian aviation authorities and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Escalating US-Iran tensions over the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran has restricted shipping, form the primary driver of trader sentiment, with President Trump's April threats of strikes on Iranian power plants and bridges if closures persist amplifying risks of military retaliation. Yesterday's Iranian missile and drone attacks on the UAE—the first since the early April ceasefire—prompted partial UAE airspace restrictions, signaling broader regional de-escalation fragility despite no qualifying Iranian airspace closure in the past 30 days. Traders weigh IRGC naval provocations, US escort firings on fast boats, and Hormuz negotiations, with potential strikes as early as Tuesday and ongoing diplomacy via Pakistan potentially tipping probabilities amid oil market volatility.

title: Elon Musk # tweets April 28 - May 5, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve according to the number of times Elon Musk (@elonmusk), posts on X from April 28 12:00 PM ET to May 5, 2026 12:00 PM ET.

For the purposes of this market, only main feed posts, quote posts and reposts will count.

Replies will NOT count towards the total - however, replies on the main feed such as https://x.com/elonmusk/status/1786073478711353576 will be counted by the tracker.

Deleted posts will count as long as they remain available long enough to be captured by the tracker (~5 minutes).

Community reposts which are not counted by the tracker not count toward the total.

The resolution source for this market is the 'Post Counter' figure for posts found at https://xtracker.polymarket.com. Individual posts can be viewed by clicking "Export Data". If the tracker does not update correctly in accordance with the rules, X itself may be used as a secondary resolution source.

eventMetadata.context_description: Oklahoma City Thunder enter Game 1 of the Western Conference Semifinals with home-court advantage at Paycom Center after a dominant regular season (64-18 record), having routed the Lakers 121-92 in November behind Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's 30 points. Los Angeles advanced via a gritty six-game upset over the Rockets, capped by LeBron James' 28 points, seven rebounds, and eight assists in a 98-78 road clincher, but face a massive setback with Luka Doncic officially out (Grade 2 left hamstring strain from early April). Thunder counter with Jalen Williams sidelined (hamstring from first-round win over Suns), testing their depth; recent injury reports underscore mutual vulnerabilities, while OKC's elite defense, rest edge, and playoff momentum shape trader consensus on a tightly contested opener despite LA's veteran resilience.

title: Indian Premier League: Delhi Capitals vs Chennai Super Kings
description:
This market refers to the cricket match between Delhi Capitals and Chennai Super Kings scheduled for May 5 2026 in Indian Premier League.

This market resolves according to the finalized match result as published by https://www.espncricinfo.com/.  

DLS/DRS, over-rate penalties, forfeit/walkover, or any other on-field ruling that leads the competition to declare a winner are treated as ordinary wins.

If the match ends tied and the playing conditions provide an on-field tiebreak (e.g., Super Over), the winner determined by that tiebreak will be used for resolution. The primary resolution source for this market is the official statistics of the event as recognized by the governing body or event organizers. However, if the governing body or event organizers have not published final match statistics within 2 hours after the event's conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead.

eventMetadata.context_description: Chennai Super Kings enter this IPL clash at Arun Jaitley Stadium hampered by a season-long injury crisis, with MS Dhoni sidelined by a persistent calf injury, alongside absences of Nathan Ellis, Khaleel Ahmed, Ayush Mhatre, and early misses for Dewald Brevis, yet they gained momentum thrashing Mumbai Indians by 8 wickets three days ago to climb to sixth in the points table with four wins from nine. Delhi Capitals, seventh with matching 4-5 record, arrive boosted by a recent victory over Rajasthan Royals that propelled them up the ladder, leveraging the batting paradise pitch with small boundaries and true pace favoring high scores and chases. Both sides eye playoff spots in a tight mid-table battle, where toss, powerplay execution, and spin in the middle overs could prove decisive amid dew factors.

eventMetadata.context_description: Oklahoma City Thunder lead trader consensus at 59.5% implied probability for the 2026 NBA Champion after securing the Western Conference top seed and advancing past the Suns in the first round, now facing the Lakers in conference semifinals—whom they swept 4-0 in the regular season—bolstered by home-court advantage and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's MVP-level play despite Jalen Williams' Game 1 absence. San Antonio Spurs sit at 15.3% as the No. 2 West seed but trail Minnesota Timberwolves 0-1 following a narrow 104-102 loss in their semifinal opener, testing Victor Wembanyama's two-way impact. Eastern contenders like New York Knicks (9.4%) and Detroit Pistons (5.1%) reflect competitive semis, with Knicks winning early games amid the Pistons' league-best 60-22 regular-season mark, though West dominance caps their overall paths.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices Robert F. Kennedy Jr. as the frontrunner at 49% implied probability for the 2028 Republican presidential nomination, narrowly ahead of Vice President J.D. Vance at 39.2% and Secretary of State Marco Rubio at 21.1%, capturing the fluid post-Trump GOP succession dynamics with over $590 million in volume reflecting skin-in-the-game assessments. RFK Jr.'s lead stems from his high-profile HHS role advancing the Make America Healthy Again agenda, highlighted in recent Senate testimony on April 21 amid mixed reviews on agency overhauls and personnel changes. Vance's position has softened due to backlash over Iran negotiations and a 21-point approval dip, while Rubio gains from donor support, CPAC straw poll surges to 35%, and Trump's reported praise contrasting Vance. This tight contest persists amid no Trump endorsement and Vance-Rubio rivalry; separation could arise from midterm results, primary announcements, or scandals before the 2028 primaries.

eventMetadata.context_description: Arsenal hold a strong position heading into their UEFA Champions League semi-final second leg against Atletico Madrid at the Emirates on May 5, following a dominant 4-0 league-phase win over the Spanish side in October. Atletico's momentum has stalled after a heartbreaking Copa del Rey final penalty-shootout loss to Real Sociedad on April 18, where key forwards Ademola Lookman and Alexander Sorloth sustained injuries, casting doubt on their fitness for the first leg at the Metropolitano on April 29 and exposing defensive vulnerabilities. Leading the Premier League table, Arsenal contend with Martin Odegaard's ongoing knee issue and Bukayo Saka's ankle doubt ahead of their April 25 Newcastle clash, while Atletico sit fourth in La Liga amid a form dip—traders weigh home-soil resilience against Arsenal's attacking firepower and head-to-head edge.

title: Next French Presidential Election
description:
The next French presidential election is currently expected to be held around April 2027.  This market pertains to the outcome of the next French presidential election, regardless of whether it follows the scheduled end of the current term or is held earlier. 

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

The President of France is elected via a two-round system; a candidate must secure over 50% of the vote to win outright in the first round. If no candidate achieves this, the top two contenders advance to a runoff.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins this election.

This market includes any potential second round. If, for any reason, the results of the election are not known by December 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

This market will resolve based on the result of the election as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. If there is ambiguity, this market will resolve based solely on the official results as reported by the French Government, specifically the Ministry of the Interior (https://www.interieur.gouv.fr/).

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus prices Jordan Bardella at 23.5% and Édouard Philippe at 20.5% to win France's 2027 presidential election, reflecting a tight race driven by recent Toluna Harris polls from late April showing Bardella leading first-round intentions at 34-35% amid persistent political instability since the 2024 snap legislative elections and public frustration over purchasing power and immigration. Philippe's 19% first-round support positions him as the leading central challenger for a likely second-round duel, bolstered by his Le Havre municipal reelection despite RN's failure to capture major cities. Left fragmentation caps Jean-Luc Mélenchon at 8.5%, keeping the field open. Separation could arise from party primaries, economic shifts, scandals, or left-wing consolidation ahead of the April 2027 first round.

title: Eurovision Winner 2026
description:
This market will resolve to the country whose candidate for Eurovision 2026 wins.

If at any point it is impossible for the listed candidate to win Eurovision 2026 based on the rules of the competition (i.e. they are eliminated), this market may immediately resolve to "No".

If no winner is announced by July 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve "Other". All ties will be broken according to EBU's official Eurovision rules.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Eurovision (https://eurovision.tv/), including live footage of Eurovision 2026, however a consensus of credible reporting will suffice.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus crowns Finland the Eurovision 2026 frontrunner at 35% implied probability, propelled by Linda Lampenius and Pete Parkkonen's violin-driven pop-rock anthem "Liekinheitin," which crushed Finland's UMK national final in January and maintained dominance through pre-parties and first Vienna rehearsals kicking off May 1. Greece's Akylas vaulted to 18% with "Ferto"'s infectious televote momentum from recent pre-party showcases, challenging Denmark's jury-favored entry at 14% and Australia's consistent 8-9% draw. Staging refinements in early rehearsals have solidified Finland's balanced jury-televote appeal, echoing past winners like Nemo. Semi-finals on May 12-14 and grand final May 16 loom as key catalysts, where live execution could spark upsets in this volatile contest.

title: LoL: Dplus KIA vs Nongshim Red Force (BO3) - Esports World Cup Korea Qualifier Playoffs
description:
This market refers to the LoL Upper bracket quarterfinal 2 match between Dplus KIA and Nongshim Red Force in the Esports World Cup Korea Qualifier Playoffs, initially scheduled for May 4 at 7:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to "Dplus KIA" if Dplus KIA win the match against Nongshim Red Force.

This market will resolve to "Nongshim Red Force" if Nongshim Red Force win the match against Dplus KIA.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or is delayed beyond 7 days from the scheduled date without a winner determined, this market will resolve to 50-50. 

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team wins due to the opponent's forfeiture, disqualification, or walkover, this market will resolve to the team who wins. 

If the match ends in a forfeit, disqualification, or walkover (team withdraws before the start and the other wins automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50. 

The resolution source for this market will be official information from https://gol.gg/esports/home. However, if https://gol.gg/esports/home has not published final results within 2 hours after the event’s conclusion, a consensus of credible reporting may be used instead including video evidence.

In cases where a team’s listed name includes minor discrepancies from the resolution source, this market will resolve based on the underlying real-world match rather than exact name matching. Recognizable abbreviations, alternate or erroneous spellings, sponsor tags, affiliate or academy designations, regional identifiers, and minor formatting differences will be treated as referring to the same team, provided the intended team can be clearly and uniquely identified within the relevant competition. If a listed team name has no reasonable connection to any participating team, or if it matches or could reasonably refer to another team in the same competition such that the intended team cannot be unambiguously determined, this market will resolve 50-50.

eventMetadata.context_description: Dplus KIA enters this BO3 upper bracket quarterfinal in the Esports World Cup 2026 Korea Qualifier Playoffs as the higher-seeded LCK contender, holding 4th place in Split 2 standings at 6-4 while Nongshim RedForce languishes 7th at 4-6. DK boasts overwhelming historical dominance with 23 series wins in 28 head-to-heads (82% win rate, 52-15 maps), though NS pulled off a stunning 2-0 sweep in their latest LCK Rounds 1-2 clash. Recent form favors neither decisively: DK fell 1-2 to Gen.G three days ago, while NS dropped 0-2 decisions to T1 and Gen.G last week amid inconsistent macro play. Winner advances to face Hanwha Life Esports for a main event qualifier spot, with no major roster changes or patch shifts reported.

eventMetadata.context_description: Hanwha Life Esports enters the BO3 upper bracket quarterfinal heavily favored in trader consensus, riding a dominant seven-series win streak in LCK 2026 Rounds 1-2, including a 2-1 upset over T1 on May 1, sweeps of Gen.G and KT Rolster last week, and a prior 2-0 rout of DN SOOPers on April 16. DN SOOPers, mired at the bottom of LCK standings with a 1-9 record, advanced via a 2-1 play-in win over DRX yesterday but stumbled with losses to BRION and FearX in the past 48 hours. HLE's superior roster synergy and head-to-head edge underscore the lopsided matchup, though BO3 format leaves slim upset room for DNS momentum shifts.

title: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in May 2026?
description: What will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit in May 2026?

markets.question: Will WTI Crude Oil (WTI) hit (HIGH) $150 in May?
markets.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if, at any point after market creation during May 2026, any 1-minute candle for the Active Month of WTI Crude Oil futures has a final "High" price equal to or above the listed price. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No". 

Prices will be used exactly as published by Pyth, without rounding.

If the Active Month contract does not trade at all during the listed time frame, this market will resolve to "No".

Only prices achieved during the applicable trading session for the underlying market will be considered. Under the standard schedule, trading is open from 6:00:00 PM ET Sunday through 5:00:00 PM ET Friday, with a daily break from 5:00:00 PM ET to 6:00:00 PM ET, except where modified by holiday or special-session hours. 

Per CME contract specifications for WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures, a contract’s last trading day is three business days prior to the 25th calendar day of the month preceding the contract's delivery month (or four business days prior if the 25th calendar day is not a business day).

The active month changes at the start of the second trading session prior to the nearest listed contract’s last trading session. At that point, the next listed contract becomes the active month (i.e., for the final three trading sessions of the nearest listed contract, the contract for the next month is the active month). The trading session for a given business day typically begins at 6:00 PM ET on the prior calendar date.

For example, if the 25th of the month is a Saturday, the last trading session for the nearest listed contract is the session for Tuesday the 21st, and the next listed contract becomes the active month at the start of the trading session for Friday the 17th (6:00 PM ET on Thursday), assuming a standard trading calendar.

If the relevant Pyth data is unavailable due to a system outage, data failure, or other technical disruption that prevents verification of the required 1-minute candle data, the official daily high price published for the Active Month WTI Crude Oil (CL) futures contract by CME Group may be used to determine whether the listed price was reached during the applicable trading session.

In the event of a contract specification change, feed change, or similar structural modification affecting the underlying market during the listed time frame, this market will resolve based on adjusted prices as displayed on Pyth.

The resolution source for this market is Pyth — specifically, the Active Month WTI Crude Oil futures "High" prices available at https://pythdata.app/explore?search=WTI, with the chart settings configured for 1-minute candles. Historical 1-minute candles may be accessed by appending a Unix timestamp (seconds) to the Pyth chart URL using the "t=" parameter.

eventMetadata.context_description: WTI crude oil prices surged to 2026 highs above $106 per barrel on May 4 amid escalating Middle East tensions, including Iranian drone strikes near the Strait of Hormuz and attacks on shipping, injecting a geopolitical risk premium before pulling back 4% to $102.31 today as traders positioned for OPEC+'s 206,000 bpd production quota increase in May. A supportive 6.2 million barrel U.S. crude inventory draw for the week ended May 1 underscores tightening supply, though softening Chinese imports and a backwardated futures curve—with June at $102 and July near $98—signal caution on sustained upside. Traders monitor weekly EIA reports starting May 7 and the June 7 OPEC+ meeting for resolution catalysts.

eventMetadata.context_description: The top-seeded Detroit Pistons welcome the fourth-seeded Cleveland Cavaliers to Game 1 of the Eastern Conference semifinals on May 5, both squads emerging from grueling seven-game first-round triumphs over the Orlando Magic and Toronto Raptors. Pistons' home-court advantage, bolstered by their league-best 60-22 regular-season mark and Cade Cunningham's full recovery from a collapsed lung, underpins trader consensus favoring Detroit in this closely contested clash. Cleveland's Donovan Mitchell and James Harden must counter with star power amid fatigue from back-to-back intensity, while no major injuries mar official reports. Short rest and divisional familiarity—after splitting their four regular-season meetings—heighten upset potential in the best-of-seven series.

title: US x Iran permanent peace deal by...?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if Iran and the United states agree to a permanent peace deal by the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

A permanent peace deal refers to any agreement which explicitly indicates that military hostilities between the United States and Iran have ended or will permanently cease, or uses equivalent language clearly signaling a lasting end to military hostilities between the United States and Iran. Agreements that are explicitly temporary or which do not include a definitive agreement to end military hostilities between the US and Iran on a lasting basis (e.g. a temporary extension of the two-week ceasefire agreement announced on April 7, 2026), will not qualify.

A qualifying agreement will be considered to have been established if either of the following conditions are met:

- The United States and Iran each sign or formally adopt a written agreement (e.g. a treaty or multi-point agreement) which meets the above criteria.

- Both the governments of the United States and Iran provide clear public confirmation that a qualifying agreement has been definitively established. Negotiations, statements of progress, or other statements which do not constitute a definitive announcement that a qualifying agreement has been reached will not count.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing indirect US-Iran negotiations, mediated by Pakistan, have resumed amid a fragile ceasefire holding since early April 2026, following US military strikes that dismantled key Iranian air defenses and infrastructure. Iran recently submitted a revised multi-point peace proposal emphasizing Strait of Hormuz reopening and sanctions relief before addressing its nuclear program, but President Trump deemed it unacceptable without ironclad commitments against nuclear weapons development—a core US red line echoed by Vice President Vance after prior Islamabad talks collapsed. Sticking points include ballistic missiles, reparations, and regional proxies, with no breakthroughs in multiple rounds despite extensions. Traders weigh diplomatic momentum against historical mistrust and escalation risks, with upcoming envoy discussions potentially pivotal before any ceasefire deadline.

title: Russia x Ukraine ceasefire by May 31, 2026?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is an official ceasefire agreement, defined as a publicly announced and mutually agreed halt in military engagement, between Russia and Ukraine by May 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET.

If the agreement is officially reached before the resolution date, this market will resolve to "Yes," regardless of whether the ceasefire officially starts afterward.

Only ceasefires which constitute a general pause in the conflict will qualify. Ceasefires which only apply to energy infrastructure, the Black Sea, or other similar agreements will not qualify.

Any form of informal agreement will not be considered an official ceasefire. Humanitarian pauses will not count toward the resolution of this market.

A peace deal or political framework will qualify if it includes a publicly announced and mutually agreed halt in military engagement, effective on a specific date. Frameworks or agreements that outline terms for a future peace but do not include an explicit, dated commitment to stop fighting will not count.

This market's resolution will be based on official announcements from both Russia and Ukraine; however, a wide consensus of credible media reporting stating an official ceasefire agreement between Russia and Ukraine has been reached will suffice.

title: F1 Drivers' Champion
description:
This market will resolve according to the listed driver that finishes 1st in the driver standings for the 2026 F1 season.

This market will resolve as soon as the official results of the final scheduled race of the 2026 F1 season are known.

If multiple drivers tie for first place in the drivers standings, this market will resolve according to the tiebreak procedure used by F1 to determine the 2026 F1 Drivers’ champion.

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed driver to win the 2026 F1 Drivers Championship based on the rules of F1 (e.g., they are mathematically eliminated from contention), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the F1 season is permanently canceled or has not been completed by February 28, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Formula 1.

eventMetadata.context_description: Kimi Antonelli leads trader consensus at 40.5% implied probability for the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship after extending his points lead to 100 over George Russell's 80 with a dominant Miami Grand Prix victory on May 3, marking his third win in four races alongside China and Japan triumphs. Mercedes' superior adaptation to the new active aero and energy management regulations has propelled their 1-2 finishes, positioning Russell as the 27.5% second-favorite in an intra-team title fight, bolstered by his Australian opener win. Lando Norris surges to 11.1% following a strong P2 in Miami, reflecting McLaren's rising race pace, while Max Verstappen's 5.6% reflects Red Bull's struggles with poor starts and regulatory complaints, leaving the field competitive early in the 24-race calendar.

title: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by May 15?
description:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls (“Arrivals of Ships”) for the Strait of Hormuz equal to or above 60 for any date between market creation and May 15, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

Daily transit calls include container, dry bulk, roll-on/roll-off, general cargo, and tanker ships. Ships not reported by IMF Portwatch will not be considered.

This market will resolve as soon as IMF Portwatch publishes a 7-day moving average of transit calls equal to or above the specified level, or once data has been published for the final date in the specified period and no such value has been published. If no data has been published for the final date of the specified period within 14 calendar days (ET) after the end of that period, this market will resolve based on data published up to that point.

Revisions to previously published data points made within this market’s timeframe will be considered. However, they will not disqualify a previously published data point from qualifying. Revisions to previously published data points after data is published for May 31, 2026, however, will not be considered.

The resolution source for this market will be IMF Portwatch, specifically the transit calls data published for the Strait of Hormuz at https://portwatch.imf.org/pages/cb5856222a5b4105adc6ee7e880a1730, both in the chart and through downloadable files.

eventMetadata.context_description: Ongoing US-Iran deadlock sustains severe restrictions on Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic, with only Iran-linked vessels transiting under Tehran's new maritime control mechanism announced this week, keeping volumes at under 10% of normal daily levels of 120-140 ships. Iranian Revolutionary Guards threats against non-compliant routes and reports of sustained attacks on US destroyers in the strait underscore fragility of the recent ceasefire, strained further by incidents near UAE ports. Traders' near-unanimous 97.7% consensus on "No" reflects months of disruptions since late February strikes, absent diplomatic breakthroughs or de-escalation signals before May 15 resolution based on IMF Portwatch data. A sudden bilateral agreement or enforced truce could shift odds, though structural military postures make normalization improbable.

title: Fed Decision in June?
description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal funds range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

This market will resolve to the amount of basis points the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is changed by versus the level it was prior to the Federal Reserve's June 2026 meeting.

If the target federal funds rate is changed to a level not expressed in the displayed options, the change will be rounded up to the nearest 25 and will resolve to the relevant bracket. (e.g. if there's a cut/increase of 12.5 bps it will be considered to be 25 bps)

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for June 16-17, 2026 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their June meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No change" bracket.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket prices a 95.5% implied probability of no change in the federal funds rate at the June 16-17 FOMC meeting, driven by the Federal Reserve's April 28-29 decision to hold steady at 3.50%-3.75% amid sticky March CPI inflation at 3.3% year-over-year and resilient labor markets, with March nonfarm payrolls adding 178,000 jobs and unemployment steady at 4.3%. This reflects cooling rate-cut expectations following Powell's cautious comments on persistent price pressures and stable growth, aligning with CME FedWatch futures showing similar positioning. Realistic challenges include softer-than-expected May CPI data due May 12 or weaker nonfarm payrolls, potentially reviving 25 basis point cut odds now at 2.9%.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent polls, including the EVITARUS survey (May 4) and Impact Research (May 5), show Xavier Becerra tied with Steve Hilton at 18-23% in the June top-two primary for California governor, with Tom Steyer close at 12-14% and undecideds at 14-23%, fueling trader consensus on a tight Becerra-Steyer duel at 39% each for the November winner. Becerra's surge stems from Eric Swalwell's April scandal-driven exit, consolidating Democratic support behind his extensive government experience as former attorney general and HHS secretary, plus fresh endorsements from unions like SEIU and Rep. Jim Clyburn. Steyer counters with massive self-funding, progressive alliances such as Our Revolution, and appeal to independents on climate and affordability. GOP vote-splitting between Hilton and Chad Bianco heightens top-two risks, but California's Democratic dominance favors primary consolidation; upcoming debates, ad spending surges, or further endorsements could tip the balance.

title: US x Iran diplomatic meeting by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count. 

The meeting must be in-person and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if there is a diplomatic meeting between representatives of the United States and Iran by the listed date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A diplomatic meeting refers to a deliberate meeting between representatives of the listed countries who are acting in an official capacity and are authorized to engage in negotiation or diplomacy regarding US-Iranian relations on behalf of their governments. Meetings conducted indirectly, for example, through designated mediators, facilitators, or interlocutors acting with the knowledge and authorization of the relevant governments, will qualify. 

Brief greetings, chance encounters, or talks otherwise not deliberately aimed at diplomacy or negotiation will not count.

The meeting must be in-person (including indirect in-person meetings) and must be publicly acknowledged by either government or reported by a consensus of credible media. Remote meetings, phone calls, or other meetings where the relevant parties are not present will not count.

The resolution sources for this market will be official information from the governments of the United States and Iran, and a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: US-Iran indirect diplomatic conversations resumed in early May 2026 amid a fragile ceasefire and US blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, with envoy Steve Witkoff citing regained momentum while President Trump dismissed Iran's latest proposal as likely unacceptable. Last month's marathon face-to-face talks in Pakistan, the highest-level direct engagement since 1979, collapsed after 15 hours without agreement on nuclear curbs, sanctions relief, or permanent ceasefire terms. Iran recently set a one-month negotiation deadline, as a Pentagon briefing underscored ongoing military tensions. Key hurdles include maximalist US demands and Tehran's uranium enrichment stance, with potential for Oman- or Pakistan-mediated breakthroughs offsetting trader skepticism on near-term in-person meetings.
